summary: Full re-test of the rebuilt ReviewBoost (simple sidebar + table dashboard). Backend: created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py with 25 pytest cases covering auth (login/me/logout/change-password/bcrypt/cookies), settings GET/PUT + Google-link validation, categories CRUD + duplicate/404, reviews generate/list/edit/regenerate/delete with persistence re-GETs, public page + use (status flip, lifetime counter, session cookie) and QR. 25/25 passed. Frontend: Playwright runs on the preview URL covered login, protected-route redirect, Reviews list (link banner/ACTIVE pill/3 stat tiles/table columns/4 row actions), inline edit + reload persistence, single regenerate (AI text changed), delete (count drop), Add New (prefill from profile, count 10, tone Friendly, language Other -> extra input, 10 reviews generated), Categories add/delete + datalist suggestion, My Business (values, ACTIVE, QR data-url, copy/download buttons, invalid google link error toast, valid save toast), Change Password (wrong current -> error, successful change + reverted back to ReviewBoost123!), public /r/<slug> page on mobile (6 tappable cards, tap -> redirect to Google Maps review URL, USED status + 'Used by customers' count incremented), logout, mobile hamburger open/close. Only 2 cosmetic/CSS issues found; all functional flows pass.

minor.issue: 'used' tile uses business.lifetime_used, which can exceed the number of rows badged USED because regenerate resets a used review back to 'available' and deletes remove used rows. Intentional? If not, stats can look inconsistent (observed used=3 while only 2 rows showed USED).
Silently resets status to 'available' for an already USED review, so a customer-consumed review can be recycled without any audit trail.

ui_bugs.issue: The X (close) button is visible on desktop: styles.css line 36 '.sidebar-close { display: none; }' is overridden by the later, equal-specificity '.icon-btn { display: inline-grid; }' (line 59). Move .sidebar-close below .icon-btn or use 'display: none !important' / a media query for >900px.

At 390x844 the long public URL anchor (414px wide) causes page-level horizontal overflow (documentElement.scrollWidth 430 > 390). Add overflow-wrap:anywhere / word-break:break-all to .link-banner a (or max-width:100%). Add New page has no overflow; the table itself is fine because .table-wrap scrolls.

issues: Copy icon and ACTIVE pill wrap onto their own line below the wrapped URL, looking detached from 'Your review link:'
3 stat tiles wrap 2+1 leaving an unbalanced row
Delete review and delete category act immediately with no confirmation dialog - easy accidental data loss for non-technical owners

action_items: Fix .sidebar-close CSS ordering so the X does not show on desktop
Add word-break/overflow-wrap to the public review link so the Reviews page has no horizontal overflow on mobile
Decide whether 'Used by customers' should be lifetime_used or the live count of USED rows (currently they can disagree after regenerate/delete)
Consider a confirm step before deleting a review/category
critical_code_review_comments: regenerate_review builds GenerateIn with count=10 then calls generate_reviews(cfg, 1): the prompt asks for 10 reviews and 9 are discarded - wasteful LLM spend, pass count=1 in the prompt.
GET /api/public/{slug} falls back to returning all rows ('or rows') when every review is hidden by the session cookie, so a repeat customer can be shown an already-used review.

Frontend Reviews/AddReview pages have no loading skeleton or error state; on a slow /reviews call the page renders 0/0/0 stats which looks like data loss (tests had to add explicit waits because prefill/datalist read as empty for ~2s).
Old collections review_templates and password_reset_tokens are now unused/dead; /api/auth/forgot-password documented in test_credentials.md no longer exists.
seed_data_creation: Used the existing demo owner (owner@reviewboost.demo). Created and deleted TEST_ categories and TEST_QA reviews; UI run generated 10 'qa-haircut-check' reviews on the demo account (left in place, total now 24) and consumed 1 review via the public page (status USED).

rca_of_the_issue: Desktop X button: CSS cascade - '.sidebar-close{display:none}' declared before '.icon-btn{display:inline-grid}' with identical specificity. Mobile horizontal scroll: the un-broken public URL anchor inside .link-banner is wider than the 390px viewport (no overflow-wrap).
